department: Engineering and Applied Science PhD (ECE, CEE, Math, CS concentrations)

deadline.value: Fall entry only. The Computer Science concentration needs complete applications by February 28; the Mathematics page gives April 1 for fall.
deadline.quote: The department’s deadline for receiving your complete application (including reference letters) is February 28

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is named for this program.

toefl_min.value: The Mathematics page sets the older iBT minimum of 80 with 20 per section for this program, overriding the Graduate School's 4.5 band rule.
toefl_min.quote: Internet-based test (IBT): a total score of 80 or above with a minimum score of 20 on each section

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold a master's in engineering, physics, chemistry, geosciences, mathematics or a related field; an exceptional student without one may be admitted with approval.
entry_route.quote: have attained a Master's degree in engineering, physics, chemistry, geosciences, mathematics, or a closely related field

also.quote: In some special cases, a student with an exceptional undergraduate academic record and aptitude for research, but without an MS degree, may be directly admitted to the PhD program

supervisor.value: No supervisor rule is given for the umbrella program; see notes for the Computer Science concentration.

funding.value: No funding rule is given for the umbrella program; see notes for the Computer Science concentration.

notes: One umbrella program. Concentrations: ECE (primary field), CEE (civil), Mathematics (math), MMCE (not mapped to a field here), and Computer Science (cs). Computer Science admits in fall only, funds through limited, competitively allocated assistantships, and encourages applicants to first find a professor who will hire them. The Mathematics page says that to be considered for financial support apply by April 1. The Mathematics page also says the chair must approve admission.
